decisions.reason: High home-page visibility, close fit to established offer, and substantial sunk investment make dropping very unlikely.
Building on the established offer and having its own page create enough public commitment to keep despite moderate visibility.
Early launch and alignment with established offer allow any disappointing results to be attributed to temporary causes, so keep.
Although distant from the established offer, public own-page commitment and sunk costs still support keeping, though drop risk is higher.
More distant and specialized, reducing centrality and commitment, but the public launch and invested resources still favor keeping.
A product line with several models built on the established offer reflects substantial investment and visibility, so drop probability is low.
